provenance: SYNTHESISED for the DCIM row 1.5c parity test, in the FortiOS shapes of the package's unit-test fixtures: a WAN port, an aggregate of two ports carrying two VLAN interfaces (one in a non-root VDOM), the monitor view keyed by name, and the monitor/network/arp list.
